notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
New Features
・Added protagonist voice acting: The main character now features full voice acting throughout the game, enhancing the storytelling experience and bringing more personality to your journey.
Bug Fixes
・Fixed various minor bugs and issues to improve overall game stability and performance.
